title: 第1段階 はじめの一歩 7

A.q: What will the mother say next?
A.ja: （母）レオ、夕ごはんができたよ。／（レオ）今行くよ、お母さん。ちょっと待って。
A.why: 「ちょっと待って」と言われたので、「いいよ。急いでね」が自然。
script: Man: I'm coming, Mom. Just a minute.

A.q: How many people are in Amy's family?
A.ja: （男）エイミー、家族は何人？／（エイミー）5人。両親と、兄と、姉と、わたし。
script: Man: How many people are there in your family, Amy?
Woman: Five. My parents, my brother, my sister, and me.

B.ja: （女）お父さん、わたしの電話はどこ？／（父）テーブルの上、本のとなりだよ。
script: Woman: Where is my phone, Dad?
Man: It's on the table, next to the book.

B.q: What does the mother do in the afternoon?
B.ja: （男）お母さん、日曜日は何をしているの？／（母）たいてい午前中に家のそうじをするよ。午後は本を読むの。
B.why: in the morning と in the afternoon を聞き分ける。
script: Man: What do you do on Sundays, Mom?
Woman: I usually clean the house in the morning. In the afternoon, I read books.

Hello. I'm Paul. I live with my family in a small house. There are four people in my family. My father is a bus driver. He gets up at five every morning. My mother is a nurse. She works at a hospital. I have a sister. She is ten years old. We eat dinner together every night.
C1.ja: こんにちは。ポールです。家族と小さな家に住んでいます。家族は4人です。父はバスの運転手です。毎朝5時に起きます。母は看護師です。病院で働いています。姉が1人います。10歳です。毎晩、いっしょに夕ごはんを食べます。

qs.q: How many people are in Paul's family?
qs.why: There are four people in my family.
My father is a bus driver. nurse はお母さん。

script: Yuki: Tom, what does your mother do?
Tom: She is a nurse. She works at night, so she sleeps in the morning.
Tom: Yes. So I cook breakfast every day.
Yuki: Really? What do you cook?
Tom: I usually cook eggs and toast.
C2.ja: （ユキ）トム、お母さんは何の仕事をしているの？／（トム）看護師だよ。夜に働くから、朝は寝ているんだ。／（ユキ）わあ、大変だね。／（トム）うん。だから毎日ぼくが朝ごはんを作るんだ。／（ユキ）本当？何を作るの？／（トム）たいてい卵とトーストだよ。

qs.why: She works at night, so she sleeps in the morning.
I usually cook eggs and toast.
